Only one owner, it has it's flaws but is reliable.

-The brakes need to be worked on sooner then later.

-The frame was reenforced by a welder several years and is very sturdy.

-The 4WD works fine however 4L going down a very steep hill with a load it clunks sometimes.

I am the only owner, there is no flood damage and it has never been in accident. I did try to do the proper maintenance but for the last couple of years I have hardly driven it.

Someone more mechanically inclined then I am can fix most of these things and it will be a good truck for a low price.
